summary.result: Based on these results, regression equations were suggested for predicting maximum and minimum grain sizes by using multiple linear regression analysis from SPSS 20.0.
summary.background: The purpose of this study was to investigate maximum and minimum grain size which eroded by wind according to soil and wind conditions, such as top soil water content, roughness, land slope, wind velocity and proportion of grain size under 0.84mm.
summary.method: In the result, maximum, minimum grain size had strong negative correlation with roughness while weak positive correlation with wind velocity.
